response.sql: SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) as fraction FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The window function SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) is evaluated after GROUP BY, summing the per-group counts across all groups with the same ordertypedist. This works in SQLite 3.25.0+.

alternatives.interpretation: For compatibility with older SQLite versions, use a CTE to compute grouped counts first, then apply the window function to a regular column instead of an aggregate.
alternatives.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, cnt as count, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) as fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
